value.title: Undo multiplication
value.explanation: An equation says two expressions have the same value. To keep that equality, do the same operation to both sides. If a nonzero coefficient multiplies x, divide both sides by it.
value.hint: Divide both sides by the coefficient multiplying x.

value.title: Undo addition
value.explanation: To isolate x when a number is added to it, subtract that number from both sides. Adding and subtracting the same number are inverse operations.
value.hint: Subtract the number added to x from both sides.

value.title: Collect terms
value.explanation: Distribute multiplication across parentheses, collect like terms, and move variable terms to one side using the same operation on both sides. Then isolate x.
value.hint: Expand the parentheses first, subtract x from both sides, then remove the constant.
